items.title: PolyShell: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type (RCE)
items.summary: This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload files with dangerous types, leading to arbitrary code execution in Adobe Commerce and Magento. It has been actively exploited in the wild since at least July 2025, with attackers injecting malicious loaders via Magento CMS blocks.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security bulletin addresses multiple critical, high, and medium vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, including arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass. Adobe recommends applying this update in addition to the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650.

items.title: BlockStrap: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine (RCE)
items.summary: A critical vulnerability in Magento and Adobe Commerce that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution through a template engine injection. This flaw, rated CVSS 10.0, was fixed in APSB26-153 but requires a manual patch for new installations.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce B2B
items.summary: This critical vulnerability, part of APSB26-153, affects Adobe Commerce B2B and has a CVSS score of 9.8. It could lead to unauthorized access and control due to incorrect authorization.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine (RCE)
items.summary: This zero-day vulnerability in Magento and Adobe Commerce allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution and has been actively exploited in the wild. Adobe released an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146) with a CVSS score of 10.0.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: An unauthenticated incorrect authorization flaw in Adobe Commerce and Magento that allows an attacker to bypass access controls and gain elevated privileges over sensitive store data and configuration. This vulnerability has a CVSS score of 9.1 and is actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (August 2026)
items.summary: This update fixes seven vulnerabilities, including five critical ones, such as an unauthenticated customer account takeover. It was shipped as isolated patch files.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability with a CVSS score of 9.3, addressed in the August 2026 security update (APSB26-92). Successful exploitation could result in security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: Another high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability with a CVSS score of 9.3, fixed in the August 2026 security update (APSB26-92). Exploitation could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (July 2026)
items.summary: This update addresses 14 vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated unrestricted file upload (CVE-2026-48356) and several incorrect authorization and stored cross-site scripting flaws.
